turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to decide what to play with my little brother this weekend.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait until I've gone through all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a racing game with silly karts that we can both play on the same screen.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a building game where we make castles and explore caves together.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a dance game that uses the controllers, which would get us both moving around.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The kart racer is a classic for siblings, it's quick to pick up and really fun to compete. The building game is better if you'd rather work together than compete. The dance game is great for a laugh but might tire out fast.
